meta.note: Each promo's `image` is the bank's full campaign poster (offer, minimum spend and period are printed on it); tnc_summary/period are read from it and the T&C by summarize_campaign.py or the Console. tnc_link is the authoritative terms.

promotions.title: Family Friendly Meals with PB Visa Credit Card
promotions.tnc_summary: 15% cash back with a minimum spend of RM250 using a PB Visa Credit Card at participating restaurants, including Mohd Chan, K-Fry Urban Korean, Din by Din Tai Fung, Dolly Dim Sum, Dancing Fish and Rembayung. Register first via PBe (keyword PBG) or SMS PBG to 68333.

promotions.title: Sign Up & Be Rewarded with your new PB & PIB Credit Card
promotions.tnc_summary: Sign-up rewards for new PB and PIB credit cards. The poster only shows card designs (Visa Infinite, World Mastercard, Visa Signature, Platinum and PIB cards); no offer, criteria or period is printed. Refer to the T&C document for details.

promotions.title: Get up to RM200 Cash Back on Overseas Transactions with PB Mastercard Debit Cards!
promotions.tnc_summary: Spend an accumulated RM400 on overseas transactions with a PB Mastercard Debit Card to get 10% cash back, up to RM200. Registration is required, either via PBe (keyword: PBUP) or by SMS PBUP to 68333. Terms and conditions apply.

promotions.title: Hairy Crab Autumn Culinary Delicacy with PB Visa Credit Card
promotions.tnc_summary: 10% cash back on hairy crab dining with a PB Visa Credit Card. Minimum spend RM400 in a single receipt, capped at RM80. Valid at Dragon-i, JW Marriott KL (Shanghai Restaurant), IWC Aquastic and Grand Harbour Fahrenheit 88. Register via PBe (keyword PBBS) or SMS PBBS to 68333.

promotions.title: RM20 OFF at Tiktok Shop with PB Mastercard Credit and Debit Card
promotions.tnc_summary: Get RM20 off at TikTok Shop when paying with a Public Bank (PB) Mastercard Credit or Debit Card, with a minimum spend of RM100. Valid from 24 September to 12 December 2026. Terms and conditions apply. PB Debit Card is protected by PIDM up to RM250,000 per depositor.

promotions.title: Get up to RM80 Cash Back on Online Transactions with PB Visa Debit Card!
promotions.tnc_summary: Get up to RM80 cash back with an accumulated spend of RM600 per month on online transactions with a PB Visa Debit Card. Registration is required, either via PBe (keyword: PBVD) or by SMS PBVD to 68333. Terms and conditions apply.

promotions.title: Lazada PayDay with PB Visa Credit Card
promotions.tnc_summary: RM20 off with minimum single-transaction spend of RM180, redeemed by collecting a voucher, valid only with PB Visa Credit Card and only on Lazada Mobile App purchases. Recurs monthly on the 24th–27th each month across the campaign period.

promotions.title: PB Visa Privileges: Relaxing Getaway with Agoda
promotions.period: Booking: Now - 31 December 2026 (Infinite/Signature); Now - 31 March 2029 (all PB/PIB Visa)
promotions.tnc_summary: Agoda hotel deals with PB Visa cards. Visa Infinite: Stay 3 Pay 2 nights (capped USD150/transaction), stays to 31 Dec 2027. Visa Signature: 16% off (capped RM120/transaction), stays to 30 Jun 2027. All PB/PIB Visa cards: 7% off (capped USD100/transaction), booking and stay until 31 Mar 2029.

promotions.title: Spend More, Earn More & WIN BIG ANG POW with PB Visa Credit Card
promotions.tnc_summary: Monthly cash back on local spend with a PB Visa Credit Card: RM48 for RM2,000 + 5 transactions, RM118 for RM5,000 + 10, RM218 for RM9,000 + 15. Spend RM38,000 in a month to enter monthly ang pow draws (4x RM8,888, 20x RM3,388, 32x RM1,188). Register via PBe (keyword PBV) or SMS PBV to 68333.

promotions.title: Link Your PB Visa Credit Cards To Alipay & Get Cash Back
promotions.tnc_summary: Link a PB Visa Credit Card to Alipay to get 10% cash back with a minimum spend of RM200 in Mainland China. Register first via PBe (keyword PBGR) or SMS PBGR to 68333.

promotions.title: Buy 1 Get 1 Air Ticket with PB Mastercard Credit Card
promotions.tnc_summary: Buy 1 get 1 air ticket to China on Malaysia Airlines with minimum accumulative spend RM20,000. Plus Alipay/Trip.com China travel deals (coupon, discount, hotel promo) running to 31 December 2026. Call Holiday Tours & Travel to book.

promotions.title: PB UnionPay Privileges: Shopee
promotions.tnc_summary: Up to RM60 off on Shopee with a PB UnionPay Lifestyle Debit Card, per single transaction: RM20 off with RM80 minimum spend, RM35 off with RM150 minimum spend, or RM60 off with RM250 minimum spend.

promotions.title: Enjoy 0% with PB Mastercard Flexipay
promotions.tnc_summary: 0% interest instalment with PB Mastercard Flexipay on a minimum amount of RM800 over a 6-month tenure. To convert, call 03-2170 8000 or email custsvc@publicbank.com.my.

promotions.title: Complimentary Airport Lounge Access for PB RCB Mastercard Premier Debit Card
promotions.tnc_summary: Complimentary airport lounge access with a PB RCB Mastercard Premier Debit Card. Spend at least RM12,000 per quarter on online and overseas transactions for 2 visits, or at least RM10,000 for 1 visit. Valid at Plaza Premium First, Plaza Premium Lounge and Travel Club Lounge.

promotions.title: Cash Back on eWallet Top Up with PB Visa Credit Card
promotions.tnc_summary: RM40 cash back on eWallet top up with PB Visa Credit Card. Minimum top up of RM2,000 per transaction. Eligible eWallets: Boost, GrabPay, Lazada, ShopeePay, Touch 'n Go. Registration required via PBe (Key Word: PBIT) or SMS PBIT to 68333. Terms and conditions apply.

promotions.title: 0% Balance Transfer with PB Visa Credit Cards
promotions.tnc_summary: 0% balance transfer for 6 months with PB Visa Credit Cards, minimum transfer amount RM3,000. Apply via www.pbebank.com (Apply > Balance Transfer > select card), call 03-2170 8000 or email custsvc@publicbank.com.my.

promotions.title: Top-up using PB Debit Cards with RM0 Reload Fees!
promotions.tnc_summary: RM0 reload fees when using a PB Debit Card to top up eWallets such as Boost, Grab and Touch 'n Go. No campaign period is shown on the poster.

promotions.title: PB Visa Infinite Privileges: Infinite Tastes Beyond The Menu
Tan Chong Ekspres Auto Servis
promotions.tnc_summary: Car service package at all Tan Chong Ekspres Auto Servis (TCEAS) centres with PB cards: Enduro Semi Synthetic 10W40 (4L) at RM109 (normally RM190) or Fully Synthetic 5W30 (4L) at RM129 (normally RM240). Includes engine oil, oil filter, oil pan washer, multi-point inspection and labour. Call 1800-88-2447 to book.

promotions.title: PB Privileges: RM100 OFF on MHflypass purchase with Journify
promotions.tnc_summary: MYR100 off MHflypass (1 pass, 3 return trips, Malaysia/ASEAN) using code PUBLIC100, exclusively for PB credit & debit cardmembers. Valid for all passes except Malaysia Zone 1.

promotions.title: PB UnionPay SplendorPlus Privileges: Enjoy 1% Cash Back in Mainland China
promotions.tnc_summary: Enjoy 1% cash back on every purchase made in mainland China with a PB UnionPay SplendorPlus Debit Card. Cash back is capped at RM300 per month. Scan the QR code on the poster for additional merchant offers. Terms and conditions apply.

promotions.title: PB Privileges @ Trip.com
promotions.period: Booking: 7 August - 31 December 2026; Stay/Travel: 7 August 2026 - 31 March 2027
promotions.tnc_summary: Trip.com deals with PB cards. Hotels: 10% off China hotels (PBCHINA10), 9% off for new users (PBSTAY9), 7% off for existing users (PBSTAY7). Flights (PBTRIPFLY): RM30 off with RM1,000 minimum spend, RM60 off with RM1,400 minimum spend. Book at my.trip.com/w/publicbankmy.

promotions.title: 0% Balance Transfer with PB Mastercard Credit Cards
promotions.tnc_summary: 0% balance transfer for 6 months on PB Mastercard Credit Cards, minimum transfer RM2,000. Apply at pbebank.com (Apply > Balance Transfer > select card), or call 03-2170 8000 / email custsvc@publicbank.com.my to convert.

promotions.title: Discover Amazing Thailand with PB Visa Card
promotions.tnc_summary: PB Visa offers in Thailand: 30% off Grab, 20% off TAGTHAi Pass, complimentary Airportels luggage delivery, and dining discounts at Hyatt, Westin and Courtyard hotels. Shopping vouchers at Central, Siam Paragon/Emporium/EmQuartier and ICONSIAM/Siam Center (minimum spend THB4,000). Spa discounts at Oasis, Health Land and Cenvaree. Scan the QR code to unlock offers.

promotions.title: PB Mastercard Privileges: Agoda's Year Round Offer
promotions.tnc_summary: Agoda hotel booking discount with PB Mastercard. PB World Mastercard Credit Card: 12% off, capped at US$45. All other PB Mastercard credit and debit cards: 8% off, capped at US$25.

promotions.title: PB Privileges @ Advance Vision Eye Specialist Centre
promotions.tnc_summary: RM600 off the High Power TransPRK package at Advance Vision Eye Specialist Centre, Damansara Utama: PB price RM4,988 (normally RM5,588), with 0% instalments up to 12 months (ZIIP/ZPIP). Includes pre-op screening, post-op medicine, 5 follow-ups and lifetime power warranty.

promotions.title: PB Mastercard Privileges @ Alipay
promotions.tnc_summary: PB Mastercard on Alipay in Mainland China. New users: RMB30 coupon after linking the card and spending at least RMB300. Existing users: RMB30 instant discount with a minimum spend of RMB1,000.

promotions.title: PB Privileges @ UTAR Hospital
promotions.tnc_summary: 20% off Preventive Health Screening and Restorative T&CM Wellness at UTAR Hospital, Kampar. PB Premium Wellness (PB Visa Infinite, World Mastercard, Visa Signature credit cards, Red Carpet Banking Mastercard Elite/Gold Debit): RM888 male, RM927 female. PB Signature Wellness (other PB cardmembers): RM468 male, RM488 female. Book via WhatsApp 012-968 3761 or contact@utarhospital.org.my.

promotions.title: PB Privileges at Sunway Resort Hotel, Sunway Pyramid Hotel & Sunway Lagoon Hotel
promotions.tnc_summary: 15% off the best available rate for PB World Mastercard, Infinite and Signature cards (code PBB15); 10% off for other PB cards (PBB10). Applies at Sunway Resort, Pyramid and Lagoon Hotels. Also 15% off food and non-alcoholic beverages at Sunset Terrace and Cafe West. Enquiries: 03 7492 8000.

promotions.title: PB Visa Privileges: 15% OFF on Selected Concert Tickets at Malaysian Philharmonic Orchestra
promotions.tnc_summary: 15% off selected Malaysian Philharmonic Orchestra concert tickets with PB Visa Infinite or PB Visa Signature Credit Card. Use promo code MVISA15 at www.dfp.com.my. Terms and conditions apply.

promotions.title: PB Privileges @ 100glasses
promotions.tnc_summary: 30% off glasses at 100glasses.my with PB cards, with a minimum spend of RM99. Use promo code PBB30; scan the poster QR code to shop. Terms and conditions apply.

promotions.title: Ocean’s Catch Seafood Dinner Buffet Deal at Sheraton Petaling Jaya Hotel
promotions.tnc_summary: Dine 5 Pay 4 on the Ocean's Catch Seafood Dinner Buffet at Feast, Level 3, Sheraton Petaling Jaya Hotel with PB cards. Every Thursday to Saturday, 6:30 PM to 10:30 PM. RM148 nett per adult; RM118.40 nett each after discount. Price inclusive of prevailing government taxes. Terms and conditions apply.

promotions.title: PB Privileges at Braun Buffel
promotions.tnc_summary: Enjoy 10% off normal-priced items at all Braun Buffel boutiques when paying with a Public Bank or Public Islamic Bank card. No minimum spend is stated on the poster. Terms and conditions apply.

promotions.title: Get RM35 When you Register & Activate your PB SecureSign today!
promotions.tnc_summary: Get RM35 by registering and activating PB SecureSign and making 2 online transactions of any amount with an eligible PB Visa card. Download the MyPB app, register PB SecureSign in the app, then activate it at a PBB ATM or branch. Terms and conditions apply.

promotions.title: PB Privileges @ Pak Nik Burger
promotions.tnc_summary: PB Cards holders enjoy 20% off every Specialty Combo Burger Set (Camden, Sizzle Pepper, Beef Meatball) at Pak Nik Burger, Level 4 (L4-48), Selera Street, Sunway Putra Mall. Offer applicable at the Sunway Putra Mall outlet only; general terms and conditions apply as per the bank's promo policy.

promotions.title: PB Privileges @ Artaflow
promotions.tnc_summary: PB Cards offer at Artaflow Malaysia (Johor Bahru): first-trial 3-in-1 wellness package (Bemer Therapy, EECP Therapy, Infrared Sauna, 30 min each) with free doctor consultation. RM99 for 1 person (RRP RM700) or RM150 for 2 persons (RRP RM1,400). RSVP required via call/WhatsApp, Mon-Fri 10am-6pm.

promotions.title: Spend & Be Rewarded at vivo
promotions.tnc_summary: PB Cards offer: RM100 instant rebate on vivo V80 Lite 5G purchased with a 12-month Zero Interest/Profit Instalment Plan. Available in three variants (128GB/256GB storage), priced from RM116.58 to RM158.25/month at PB Price (RM1,399-RM1,899).

promotions.title: PB Privileges @ Cengild G. I. Medical Centre
promotions.tnc_summary: PB Privileges offers discounted health screening packages at Cengild G.I. Medical Centre, Bangsar South: Urban Heart Health Screening RM548 (normal RM638), Essential Cancer Screening RM555 (normal RM638), Heart & Cancer Screening RM799, and Cancer & Gastric Screening RM799 (both normal RM938). Each includes blood tests, cardiac/cancer markers, BCA, doctor consultation, refreshment, plus a free RM30 GrabCar code.

promotions.title: JOM RASA PENANG with PB Cards
promotions.tnc_summary: PB Cards dining promo across Penang outlets: 20%/15% off at G Hotel Gurney & Kelawai (to 30 Dec 2026); 10-15% off at Sood by Chef Ton, Hut Dining Buffet, Yakiniku Tenshin, Christoph's, Wagyu and Rice, Tsukiji Sushi, Norm, Peninsula House, The Pinn, Sifu Nyonya Cuisine; some require minimum spend (RM80-RM800) or complimentary items; validity periods vary by outlet.

promotions.title: PB Privileges @ Just Pets Megastore
promotions.tnc_summary: 20% off entrance ticket to Just Pets Megastore (Just Farm, Just Cats, Just Dogs) using promo code PBJP20 for PB cardholders. Book via shop.justpets.asia. Terms and conditions apply; full details not accessible from linked PDF.

promotions.title: Lazada Double-Digit Days with PB Visa Credit Card
promotions.period: 8th (8PM) – 11th (11:59PM) Sep 2026; 9th–12th Oct 2026; 10th–13th Nov 2026; 11th–14th Dec 2026; 1st–4th Feb 2027; 2nd–5th Mar 2027; 3rd–6th Apr 2027
promotions.tnc_summary: RM20 instant off with minimum single-transaction spend of RM180, valid only with PB Visa Credit Card and only on Lazada Mobile App purchases. Offer repeats monthly on the dates listed in the promotion period, spanning September 2026 through April 2027.

promotions.title: PB Privileges at Grand Millennium Kuala Lumpur
promotions.tnc_summary: 15% off food only at Grand Millennium Kuala Lumpur, valid at three participating outlets: The Mill Café, Lai Ching Yuen, and Bistro 160.

promotions.title: Lazada Double Date and Pay Day Sales with PB Mastercard Credit Card
promotions.tnc_summary: RM50 off with minimum spend RM500, or RM100 off with minimum spend RM1,000, in a single transaction (excluding shipping/courier) on the Lazada mobile app with a PB/PIB Mastercard credit card. Discount applies automatically at checkout, limited to one use per Lazada ID per month, and is first-come first-served on fixed quotas within eight windows: Double Date 8-11 Sep, 9-12 Oct, 10-13 Nov, 11-14 Dec (8pm start) and Pay Day 24-27 Sep, 24-27 Oct, 24-27 Nov, 24-27 Dec 2026. Product exclusions apply.

promotions.title: RM25 OFF at Lazada with PB Mastercard Credit Card
promotions.tnc_summary: RM25 off with minimum spend RM200 in a single transaction, only with PB Mastercard Credit Card, applicable to Lazada mobile app purchases only.

promotions.title: PB Privileges at Bendang
promotions.tnc_summary: 10% off Siakap (sea bass) with minimum spending of RM300 in a single receipt at Bendang. Picture for illustration purposes only.

promotions.title: PB Privileges at Kampung Lah
promotions.tnc_summary: 1 complimentary vegetable dish of choice with minimum spending of RM300 in a single receipt at Kampung Lah.

promotions.title: PB Privileges at Tingkap By Kampunglah
promotions.tnc_summary: 10% off total bill from 2:00pm to 5:00pm at Tingkap by Kampunglah.

promotions.title: PB Privileges at TAPAULAH By Kampunglah
promotions.tnc_summary: 1 complimentary Sirap with purchase of 2 Bun Bun Mak, or 1 complimentary drink with purchase of 1 drink, at Tapaulah by Kampunglah.

promotions.title: PB Privileges at Waroeng Sambal Pojok
promotions.tnc_summary: 10% off Iga Bakar (grilled beef ribs) at Waroeng Sambal Pojok.

promotions.title: Exclusive Dining Privileges with PB Visa Credit Card
promotions.tnc_summary: RM50 cashback with spending of RM688 in a single receipt at participating restaurants (Fish Market, Hee Lai Ton, Oriental Group, Grand Imperial Group, and others). Register via PBe (keyword PBCB) or SMS PBCB to 68333.

promotions.title: More eWallet Top-Ups, More Rewards with PB Mastercard Credit Card
promotions.tnc_summary: RM40 eVoucher for min RM2,000 top-up, or RM100 eVoucher for min RM4,000 top-up per transaction, on Boost, GrabPay, Lazada, ShopeePay or Touch 'n Go. Register via PBe (keyword PBVHR) or SMS PBVHR to 68333.

promotions.title: EcoWorld Home Buyer Programme
promotions.tnc_summary: Cashback on home purchases: RM200 (downpayment RM10,000-39,999), RM400 (RM40,000-99,999), RM1,000 (RM100,000+); also for 0% instalment (36mo ZIIP/ZPIP). Max one redemption per cardmember. Plus a free 16-piece cutlery set (worth RM119) with qualifying spend at EcoWorld townships.

promotions.title: PB Privileges @ 52 Pilates
promotions.tnc_summary: Up to 40% off Pilates Group Package at 52 Pilates using code PBCM. Register and redeem via WhatsApp (+6016-662 2887).

promotions.title: PB Privileges at Bateriku
promotions.tnc_summary: Get RM50 off at Bateriku (Astra batteries featured) with PB cards using code PB50. Redeem by walking in to the nearest Bateriku Pitstop, calling the call-out hotline at 011 1600 6008, or booking a battery replacement via the Bateriku Mobile App. Terms and conditions apply.
